description: Show the user's Power Day for one date: score, streak, Musts, habits, top tasks (up to 10), and tasks that are due or overdue. Use it when the user asks what is on their plan today or how today is going. It reads only; it changes nothing.

date.description: Date to show. Defaults to today. Allowed range: 30 days back to 7 days ahead.

name: get_power_day
title: Get Power Day
